item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, jointly increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and reduce learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Extra capacity may improve item discrimination, while smaller updates stabilize the wider network with normalized tied embeddings. Retain two blocks, two heads, 2× feed-forward expansion, dropout 0.2 and all other settings. Preserve masked-target training, appended-mask inference and one checkpoint per category; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor dimensions.","1":"Across all four datasets, scale each feed-forward residual contribution by 0.5: x = x + 0.5*FFN(LayerNorm(x)). Keep attention residuals unchanged, retaining pre-norm bidirectional attention, GELU, 2× feed-forward width and final LayerNorm. Attenuating feed-forward updates may extend the successful capacity reduction without the extra parameters of the unsuccessful SwiGLU trial. Preserve features, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer; use the identical architecture in the predictor.","2":"Across all four datasets, replace absolute padded-slot position IDs with chronological ranks among nonpadding tokens: padding remains 0 and real or masked positions receive 1 through sequence length. Reuse the existing positional embedding table without changing its shape or parameterization. This may share positional evidence across different history lengths more effectively on predominantly short sequences. Derive ranks solely from nonpadding locations, including mask tokens; preserve topology, loss, optimizer and appended-mask readout, and apply the same mapping during inference.","3":"Across all four datasets, divide full-catalog masked-item logits by a fixed temperature of 0.5 before the existing position-averaged cross-entropy. Sharper training probabilities may improve discrimination with the small logits induced by normalized tied item embeddings. Retain equal weighting across masked positions, avoiding the previously unsuccessful sequence averaging. Preserve masking and sampling, features, embeddings, topology, scoring/readout, optimizer and schedule. Inference keeps the existing scores and loads one checkpoint per category."}
